viewpoint._说明: 画家视角：站在论坛广场上，看着咖啡座和远处的街道。原画上传后会重新对准。

text.zh: 从这里看，就是画里的样子。
text.en: From here, you see what the painting sees.

exclusive._说明: 独家发现“星空连线”：点夜空，星星之间连出线，并显示 stars 卡片。stars 是星星在原画上的位置（0–1，从左到右、从上到下），原画上传后照画重新标。

room._说明: 户外：ground 是地面范围，bounds 是可以走动的范围（可以走到雨棚下），都写 [x最小, x最大, z最小, z最大]，单位是米。

text.zh: 梵高说，煤气灯的光是黄色和橙色的，会让蓝色显得更强烈。
text.en: Van Gogh said gaslight, being yellow and orange, makes blue more intense.

text.zh: 后来的天文研究发现，他画的星座位置，和1888年9月16日或17日夜里的星空一致。
text.en: Later astronomical research found that he painted the stars as they appeared on the night of 16 or 17 September 1888.

text.zh: 背景里深蓝色的房子，让雨棚下的暖黄色和夜空的深蓝对比更强烈。
text.en: The dark blue houses in the background strengthen the contrast between the warm yellow and the deep blue sky.

text.zh: 他画了右边一家亮着灯的小店和几根树枝，却省略了旁边的罗马遗迹。
text.en: He painted a lit shop and some tree branches on the right, but left out the Roman ruins beside it.

text.zh: 他写信给画家朋友欧仁·博赫，说画的是论坛广场上"我们常去"的那家咖啡馆。博赫的画像，就挂在梵高卧室的墙上。
text.en: He wrote to his painter friend Eugène Boch that this was the café on Place du Forum "where we used to go". Boch's portrait hangs on the wall of Van Gogh's bedroom.

label.en: See Boch's portrait in the bedroom

text.zh: 他是在夜里、在黑暗中现场画的，因为颜色在白天和晚上看起来不一样。
text.en: He painted it on the spot, in the dark, because colours look different at night than by day.

alt.en: Vincent van Gogh, Terrace of a Café at Night, 1888

caption.zh: 约1888年9月16日 · 克勒勒-米勒博物馆

title.zh: 第一幕 · 没有黑色的夜

text.zh: 梵高一直想画一幅夜景，但不想用传统的黑色和灰色，而是用丰富的颜色。
text.en: Van Gogh had long wanted to paint a night scene, not in black and grey, but full of colour.

title.zh: 第二幕 · 在黑暗中画

text.zh: 他在夜里来到论坛广场，在煤气灯下现场作画。他写信告诉妹妹威尔，他非常享受在夜里现场画画。
text.en: He went to Place du Forum at night and painted by gaslight. He wrote to his sister Wil that he enormously enjoyed painting on the spot at night.

title.zh: 第三幕 · 今天的广场

text.zh: 今天，你可以站在广场东北角，也就是他当年支画架的地方。这家咖啡馆在1990至1991年按画中的样子重新翻修过。
text.en: Today you can stand at the north-east corner of the square, where he set up his easel. The café was refurbished in 1990–91 to look like the painting.

final.zh: 夜，原来可以有这么多颜色。
final.en: The night has so many colours.
